::: {.hub-summary}

This project has been my way of learning bioinformatics and the biology of the blood–brain
barrier at the same time. It is a quantitative analysis of **coding-sequence conservation and
selection pressure in blood–brain barrier genes** across human, mouse and macaque, using
liver genes as a control group.

The site documents the whole thing: **the steps I took, the materials I used, the audit I
did afterwards, and what has to be fixed first** before this data can be reused. The
bioinformatics pipeline is a rough structure — usable, but it needs polishing. Alongside it
is a literature review, currently in progress, where I will add and comment on the papers I
read.

:::
